name: dropdown-menu
title: DropdownMenu
description: Reveal a portaled menu of actions or routes from a trigger. Single-select per item — items invoke actions immediately on activation. Supports nested sub-menus, dividers, label rows, danger items, keyboard shortcuts, checkboxes, and radio groups. Three triggers it covers: a button menu (kebab/overflow), a route menu (account, workspace switcher), and a right-click ContextMenu (variant via `trigger='context'`).
